57 Front St, Unit 101, Brooklyn (DUMBO) 11201 (718) 797-6875 - Mon-Fri 8am-8pm, Sat-Sun 10am-5pm (2nd location in Brooklyn Heights); vhvetgroup.com. A full-service clinic with the equipment and expertise to treat exotic & avian species (incubators, oxygen therapy, nebulization) alongside cats/dogs; sees guinea pigs, turtles, hedgehogs and birds, and treats some WILDLIFE by appointment (Drs. Neumann & Adelman). The most convenient exotics-capable full-service option in Brooklyn.

Drs. Sara Neumann & Amy Adelman see wildlife by appointment; 57 Front St, Unit 101, Brooklyn 11201, (718) 797-6875. A Brooklyn option for an injured wild animal a rehabber directs to a vet.
